questions.stem: Two people start at the same time from towns A and B, 160 km apart, and walk toward each other at 20 km/h and 60 km/h respectively. Find the distance from A at which they meet.
questions.explanation: They meet after 160/(20+60) hours; distance from A = 20 × 160/80 = 40 km.

questions.stem: Two people start at the same time from towns A and B, 310 km apart, and walk toward each other at 36 km/h and 26 km/h respectively. Find the distance from A at which they meet.

questions.stem: A person travels from A to B at 56 km/h and returns at 33 km/h, taking 178 hours in all. Find the total distance travelled (to and fro).
questions.explanation: One-way distance = 3696 km, so the total distance both ways = 7392 km.
